comments.body:
Scope decision + evidence.

PR #125 bundles two bumps in dependabot's 'uv-lock' group:
  * zizmor 1.28.0 -> 1.29.0  (LANDING here)
  * mcp     1.29.0 -> 2.0.0  (EXCLUDED; deferred to 732b-51df-acf2-477b)

The mcp half is a straight re-proposal of what dependabot already asked for in PR #124
(now CLOSED). Ticket 1dfd-063e-f341-48da investigated it and rejected it on evidence:
mcp 2.0 removes mcp.server.fastmcp. Re-verified against this worktree's tree at
origin/main c89a2ddcc4 — the v1 import paths are still present and unchanged:

  src/rebar/mcp_server.py:570         from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
  scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py:72     from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
  src/rebar/mcp_server.py:512         from mcp.server.transport_security import TransportSecuritySettings
  src/rebar/mcp_server.py:590         from mcp.server.auth.settings import AuthSettings
  src/rebar/_mcp_auth.py:38           from mcp.server.auth.provider import AccessToken
  src/rebar/_mcp_models.py:291        from mcp.types import ToolAnnotations

Nothing has changed since 1dfd's decision, so this ticket applies the same path-2 rule:
land the safe subset, leave mcp pinned <2. 732b remains the home for the migration.

Lock-refresh method + fidelity:
  * pyproject: the single 'zizmor==1.28.0' -> 'zizmor==1.29.0' (exact pin kept exact).
  * uv.lock regenerated with 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor' (not hand-edited).
    Resulting diff is 30 lines, confined to the zizmor package block; uv.lock 'revision'
    stays 2 (unchanged from main), and no marker churn was introduced.
  * All 11 zizmor 1.29.0 hashes (1 sdist + 10 wheels) are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the ones in
    'gh pr diff 125' — diffed and confirmed, so this reproduces dependabot's intent exactly.
  * 'uv lock --check' exits 0 (the same gate CI runs at _build-and-test.yml:67).
  * mcp confirmed still at 1.29.0 in uv.lock and '>=1.28.1,<2' in both pyproject sites.

Note on the PR's other diff noise: dependabot's uv.lock rewrite also bumps the lock
'revision' 2 -> 3 and adds extra-marker churn across ~20 unrelated packages. That is an
artifact of the newer uv dependabot runs, not part of either bump; regenerating locally
reproduces neither, which keeps this change reviewable.

compiled_state.description:
# Land dependabot PR #125 (uv-lock group) through Gerrit — zizmor 1.29.0 only

## Context / Problem

GitHub is a read-only mirror for this project: dependabot keeps opening dependency PRs
there, but they can never merge — the content has to be re-applied locally and landed as a
Gerrit change, then the PR closed by hand. PR #125 ("deps: bump the uv-lock group across 1
directory with 2 updates") is open now and proposes two bumps:

* `zizmor` `1.28.0` -> `1.29.0` — pinned EXACTLY in the `dev` group for local<->CI parity;
  `make lint` runs `zizmor .github/workflows/release.yml`.
* `mcp` `1.29.0` -> `2.0.0` (major), with the pyproject ceiling loosened `<2` -> `<3` in
  both the `mcp` and `dev` extras.

The `mcp` half is a re-proposal of what dependabot already asked for in the now-closed PR
#124. That was investigated under ticket 1dfd (entodermic-dizzying-pikeperch) and rejected
on evidence: mcp 2.0 removes the `mcp.server.fastmcp` module (verified `ModuleNotFoundError`),
which `src/rebar/mcp_server.py:570` and `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py:72` import. Other v1
import paths in the same subsystem are separately at risk under 2.0 —
`src/rebar/mcp_server.py:512` (`mcp.server.transport_security`), `:590`
(`mcp.server.auth.settings`), `src/rebar/_mcp_auth.py:38` (`mcp.server.auth.provider`), and
`src/rebar/_mcp_models.py:291` (`mcp.types`). That migration is structural work and is already
tracked as its own open ticket, 732b-51df-acf2-477b (bared-nickel-insect), "Migrate MCP
server to mcp 2.0 (fastmcp removal)". Nothing about PR #125 changes that finding, so
re-litigating it here would duplicate 732b.

## Approach

Land the **safe subset** of PR #125 — the `zizmor` bump alone — and leave the `mcp` ceiling
at `<2` so the resolver keeps `mcp` 1.29.0. This is the same path-2 decision rule that
ticket 1dfd already applied to the identical `mcp` proposal, so the two tickets stay
consistent rather than contradicting each other.

Concretely, in a fresh worktree branched from current `origin/main`:

1. Edit `pyproject.toml`: `"zizmor==1.28.0"` -> `"zizmor==1.29.0"` in the `dev` group. The
   exact pin (not a floor) is deliberate and documented in the surrounding comment; keep it
   exact.
2. Refresh the lock with `uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor` so `uv.lock` is regenerated by
   uv rather than hand-edited. CI gates on `uv lock --check` (`_build-and-test.yml:67`), so
   the committed lock must be exactly what uv produces for the edited pyproject.
3. Do NOT touch the `mcp` constraints, `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml`, or ADR 0050 —
   those are 732b's edit-set.
4. Verify, commit with a `rebar-ticket:` trailer + DCO sign-off, push to
   `refs/for/main`, land on `LLM-Review +1` + `Verified +1`, then close PR #125 with a
   comment naming the merged commit and pointing the `mcp` half at 732b.

Assume the zizmor bump is clean unless `make lint` says otherwise: zizmor tightens and adds
audits across releases, so if 1.29.0 reports a NEW finding on `release.yml`, fix that
finding in this change (that is exactly what the exact pin exists to surface).

## Scope

* `pyproject.toml` — the single `zizmor==` pin in the `dev` dependency group.
* `uv.lock` — the regenerated `zizmor` package entry (version, sdist, wheels) plus whatever
  incidental churn `uv lock` emits.
* OUT: the `mcp` 1.29.0 -> 2.0.0 bump and its `<2` -> `<3` ceiling move (deferred to 732b);
  `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml`; ADR 0050; dependabot configuration; any other open
  dependency update; `src/` and `tests/` (no source change is expected).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1: `pyproject.toml` contains `"zizmor==1.29.0"` and still contains `mcp>=1.28.1,<2`
  in both the `mcp` extra and the `dev` group — checked with
  `grep -nE 'zizmor==|mcp>=' pyproject.toml`.
- [ ] AC2: `uv.lock` records `zizmor` at `1.29.0` and `mcp` at `1.29.0` — checked with
  `grep -A1 -E '^name = "(zizmor|mcp)"$' uv.lock` — and `uv lock --check` exits 0, proving
  the committed lock matches the edited pyproject (the same gate CI runs).
- [ ] AC3: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` exits 0 in the worktree, proving
  zizmor 1.29.0 reports no finding on `release.yml`; `make typecheck` and the test suite
  also exit 0.
- [ ] AC4: A Gerrit change carrying this diff is merged into `main` with `LLM-Review +1`
  and `Verified +1` — checked by `git log origin/main` showing the commit with this
  ticket's `rebar-ticket:` trailer.
- [ ] AC5: GitHub PR #125 is in state `CLOSED` — checked with
  `gh pr view 125 --json state --jq '.state' | grep -qx CLOSED`.
- [ ] AC6: PR #125 carries a closing comment that names the merged Gerrit commit sha and
  points the `mcp` 2.0 half at ticket 732b — checked with
  `gh pr view 125 --json comments --jq '.comments[].body' | grep -q 732b` and the same
  pipeline `| grep -q "<merged-commit-sha>"`, both exiting 0.
